prompt: A war camp besieging the castle on the next hill.

card.name: Siege Camp Below the Castle Hill

site.text: A war camp on a hill facing the castle on the next hill, sitting on existing high ground with open slopes toward the besieged castle.

style.text: Rough, temporary military camp: wood palisades, canvas tents in wool, banners, torches and campfires, muddy trodden ground.

purpose.text: A war camp laying siege to the castle on the next hill, housing troops, commanders, siege engines and supplies.

card.interpretation: Site: a camp on a hill facing another hill with a castle, using existing land. Style: a rough, temporary rustic military camp of tents and palisades. Purpose: besieging the castle, so troops, commanders, siege engines and supplies. No backstory was given. Medium size with about 10 buildings, nothing built on the castle itself.

contradictions.issue: The besieged castle on the next hill is not part of this settlement and may not exist in the world.
contradictions.resolution: Only the camp is designed, oriented toward the neighbouring hill; the castle is treated as existing scenery.

assumptions: Search for a hill with another hill nearby, since no spot was given.
Style is rustic, a makeshift camp rather than permanent architecture.
Difficulty is patron, from the world defaults.

program.notes: Large striped tent-hall with a war table, maps and banners; faces the castle.
Wool tents with bedrolls, weapon racks and campfires between them.
Open-sided shed where catapults and rams are built; unfinished engines outside, on the castle-facing side.
Timber tower with a view of the castle walls.
Repairs weapons and armor; anvil, grindstone, barrels of arrows.
Food crates, hay and horses at the rear, away from the castle.
